step-1.text: Start with the drawer tower. Lay the two tower sides on their edges, holes facing each other, and screw in the cam pins.

count-1.text: This step uses 2 side panels and 8 cam pins.

step-2.text: Fit the two tower panels between the sides, one low and one under the drawer. Eight cam locks, all turned clockwise.

count-2.text: This step uses 2 tower panels and 8 cam locks.

step-3.text: Connect the left side panel to the tower with the long back panel. Dowels first, then cam locks at both ends.

count-3.text: This step uses 1 side panel, 1 back panel, 2 wood dowels and 2 cam locks.

step-4.text: Tap dowels into the top edges, set the desk top on, and screw it down from underneath through the tower and the side.

count-4.text: This step uses 1 desk top, 6 wood dowels and 6 screws.

step-5.text: Build the drawer box: sides onto the front, bottom slides into the grooves, back panel screwed on.

count-5.text: This step uses 1 drawer front, 1 drawer box part, 4 wood dowels and 4 screws.

step-6.text: Use the wall fitting to tie the desk to the wall behind it. It stops the desk from tipping if someone leans on an open drawer.

done.text: Done. Your MICKE desk is built. Give it a proud little pat.
